title: Positing
description: The scott-continuous-posit-category generator inside the transfinite-predication-category generated by predicating. Positing's domain is the transfinite-predication-category; its codomain is the scott-continuous-posit-category in which lower valuation-extension morphisms such as predication-valuation/adjoining live. This schema presents the generator boundary and does not encode the lower-level valuation update operation.
